plan.title: Bronchial epithelium cytokine footprint activity (PROGENy/TF)
plan.analytical_narrative: The research question asks which signaling pathways are active by their transcriptional footprint, not by member-gene expression — this rules out simple GSEA-on-membership or raw expression comparisons and requires a footprint/perturbation-based method (PROGENy) plus a complementary transcription-factor activity inference (CollecTRI via decoupleR), both run on the DESeq2 contrast statistic from the full tested gene set (not a thresholded list). The dataset is 6 cytokine-treated vs 6 vehicle-control bronchial epithelial samples, single batch, raw Salmon gene-level counts (12000 genes x 12 samples after excluding metadata header). Sample sample_01 has a library size ~4x below the median: per the grounded QC rule this is inspected and reported, not silently dropped, since DESeq2 size factors already account for depth differences. The pipeline: (1) sample-structure QC with library sizes, PCA and sample-distance heatmap on a blind VST, explicitly flagging sample_01; (2) DESeq2 differential expression (Wald test, apeglm-shrunken LFC, BH-adjusted, independent filtering) with condition as treated vs control (control as explicit reference level); (3) fgsea preranked GSEA on the Wald statistic against MSigDB Hallmark, then Reactome and WikiPathways human collections, as a membership-based enrichment cross-check; (4) the two footprint-based activity steps that directly answer the research question — PROGENy pathway activity (decoupleR mlm, top 500 responsive genes per pathway) and CollecTRI transcription-factor activity (decoupleR ulm) both on the Wald statistic of every tested gene; (5) an integrated report that separates the footprint-based pathway/TF activity results (the primary answer) from the membership-based GSEA (a secondary, method-dependent cross-check), states the low-depth sample's disposition, and carries full reproducibility metadata.

steps.method: vst(blind) PCA + sample distance heatmap + library size QC
keep genes with >=10 counts in >=6 samples
~condition, explicit reference level = control, contrast condition treated vs control
decoupleR mlm on PROGENy human footprint model (top 500 responsive genes), on the DESeq2 Wald statistic
decoupleR ulm on CollecTRI human regulons, on the DESeq2 Wald statistic
fgsea preranked GSEA on Wald statistic, MSigDB Hallmark + Reactome + WikiPathways human
integrated report: DE table, pathway/TF footprint activities, GSEA, QC diagnostics, session info
